title: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day
As a founder, one provider covers registered-agent service in every US state, so registering in a new state does not mean finding a new vendor
As a legal-ops lead, the provider publishes per-state appointment details: the agent address for that state, which form designates the agent, and who files it
As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received
As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch
As a legal-ops lead, the provider documents how service of legal papers is handled separately from ordinary mail, with distinct delivery commitments
As a founder, state mail and legal documents are scanned into an online account where I can read, download, and share them
As a legal-ops lead, original documents are forwarded under a documented policy, so certified mail and checks reach the company
As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
As a founder, I get alerts ahead of each state's annual report and franchise tax deadlines for every state where the provider is my agent
As a legal-ops lead, one dashboard shows every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines
As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on
As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it
As a founder switching providers, the new provider prepares or files the change-of-agent paperwork and documents each state's form and fee
As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access
As a founder, I can use the provider's address on state filings where the provider permits it, keeping my home address off the public record
As a founder, registered-agent service has a published flat annual price, with the renewal price stated up front
As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity
As an AI-native user, an agent can retrieve received legal documents and their metadata through a documented machine interface, not only a human dashboard
As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse
As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API
